items.label: Powerful Performance with Ample Memory & Storage
items.value: Experience smooth multitasking and efficient performance with the FOSSiBOT S5 smartphone. It features an octa-core Unisoc T7250 processor, combined with 4GB of physical RAM and 12GB of expandable virtual RAM, delivering up to 16GB of total memory for seamless app switching and reduced lag. With 128GB of built-in storage and support for microSD expansion up to 1TB, you’ll have plenty of space for apps, photos, videos, and files. This device is optimized for daily communication, video streaming, and running multiple applications effortlessly.

items.label: Immersive Large Display with 120Hz Refresh Rate
items.value: Enjoy a vibrant viewing experience on the 6.88-inch HD+ display, offering wide and immersive visuals for movies, games, and web browsing. The 120Hz high refresh rate ensures ultra-smooth scrolling and responsive touch controls. With a resolution of 720 x 1640 pixels and peak brightness of 450 nits, content remains clear and readable even outdoors. This large, high-refresh screen provides a comfortable and engaging experience for extended use.

items.label: Long-Lasting Battery with Fast Charging & OTG Support
items.value: Stay powered throughout the day with the massive 6000mAh battery. It supports 10W fast charging, reaching a full charge in approximately 210 minutes, and offers up to 780 hours of standby, 43 hours of talk time, 10 hours of gaming, 13 hours of HD video playback, or 40 hours of music playback. The included OTG functionality allows you to charge other small electronic devices, making this phone a reliable companion for travel, emergencies, and daily adventures.

items.label: High-Resolution Cameras & Latest Android 15 OS
items.value: Capture clear and detailed moments with the 13MP rear camera and take natural selfies or make video calls with the 8MP front camera. The FOSSiBOT S5 runs on the latest Android 15 operating system, optimized for smooth performance, enhanced privacy, and stronger security. Enjoy a stable, responsive interface and seamless multitasking, all backed by an updated system that keeps your experience secure and efficient.

items.label: Versatile Connectivity, User-Friendly Design & Warranty
items.value: Designed for convenience, this SIM-free smartphone features a slim and lightweight body (8.5mm thick, 215.6g) along with a 3.5mm headphone jack, dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, and a USB Type-C port. It supports dual Nano-SIM cards or a SIM + microSD configuration for flexible usage. Quickly unlock your device using side-mounted fingerprint sensing or facial recognition. With global network support and reliable GPS, it’s ideal for navigation and communication. Backed by a 12-month official warranty and 24-hour customer support, you can purchase with confidence.
